arxiv-2109-14035.title: Formalizing the Generalization-Forgetting Trade-Off in Continual Learning
arxiv-2109-14035.creator: R. Krishnan, Prasanna Balaprakash
arxiv-2109-14035.description: Abstract We formulate the continual learning problem via dynamic programming and model the trade-off between catastrophic forgetting and generalization as a two-player sequential game. In this approach, player 1 maximizes the cost due to lack of generalization whereas player 2 minimizes the cost due to increased catastrophic forgetting.

arxiv-2110-10297.title: On a boundary property of Blaschke products 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification: Primary 30J10, 30H05, 30H10. Key words: Blaschke products, bounded analytic function, Fatou’s theorem, radial limit.
arxiv-2110-10297.creator: Arthur A. Danielyan, Spyros Pasias
arxiv-2110-10297.description: Abstract A Blaschke product has no radial limits on a subset E E of the unit circle T T but has unrestricted limit at each point of T ∖ E T\setminus E if and only if E E is a closed set of measure zero. 1 Introduction.

arxiv-2302-03531.title: Structured Generative Models for Scene Understanding
arxiv-2302-03531.creator: Christopher K. I. Williams
arxiv-2302-03531.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christopher K. I. Williams. This position paper argues for the use of structured generative models (SGMs) for the understanding of static scenes. This requires the reconstruction of a 3D scene from an input image (or a set of multi-view images), whereby the contents of the image(s) are causally explained in terms of models of instantiated objects, each with their own type, shape, appearance and pose, along with global variables like scene lighting and camera parameters.

arxiv-2403-01926.title: IndicVoices : Towards building an Inclusive Multilingual Speech Dataset for Indian Languages
arxiv-2403-01926.creator: Tahir Javed Janki Atul Nawale, Eldho Ittan George Sakshi Joshi Kaushal Santosh Bhogale Deovrat Mehendale, Ishvinder Virender Sethi Aparna Ananthanarayanan Hafsah Faquih Pratiti Palit, Sneha Ravishankar Saranya Sukumaran Tripura Panchagnula Sunjay Murali, Kunal Sharad Gandhi Ambujavalli R Manickam K
arxiv-2403-01926.description: Abstract We present IndicVoices , a dataset of natural and spontaneous speech containing a total of 7348 hours of read (9%), extempore (74%) and conversational (17%) audio from 16237 speakers covering 145 Indian districts and 22 languages. Of these 7348 hours, 1639 hours have already been transcribed, with a median of 73 hours per language.

arxiv-2405-02895.title: Dark Energy predictions from GREA: Background and linear perturbation theory
arxiv-2405-02895.creator: Juan García-Bellido
arxiv-2405-02895.description: Abstract General Relativistic Entropic Acceleration (GREA) theory provides a covariant formalism for out-of-equilibrium phenomena in GR, extending the Einstein equations with an entropic force that behaves like bulk viscosity with a negative effective pressure. In particular, the growth of entropy associated with the homogeneous causal horizon can explain the present acceleration of the Universe, without introducing a cosmological constant.

arxiv-2406-08234.title: MaIL: Improving Imitation Learning with Mamba
arxiv-2406-08234.creator: Xiaogang Jia i {\color[rgb]{1,1,1}i} Qian Wang * † Atalay Donat † Bowen Xing ‡ Ge Li † Hongyi Zhou ‡ Onur Celik † Denis Blessing † Rudolf Lioutikov ‡ Gerhard Neumann † † Autonomous Learning Robots, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology ‡ Intuitive Robots Lab, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
arxiv-2406-08234.description: Abstract This work presents Ma mba I mitation L earning (MaIL), a novel imitation learning (IL) architecture that provides an alternative to state-of-the-art (SoTA) Transformer-based policies. MaIL leverages Mamba, a state-space model designed to selectively focus on key features of the data.

arxiv-2408-10905.title: The impact of labeling automotive AI as “trustworthy” or “reliable” on user evaluation and technology acceptance
arxiv-2408-10905.creator: John Dorsch
arxiv-2408-10905.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by John Dorsch. Abstract

This study explores whether labeling AI as either “trustworthy” or “reliable” influences user perceptions and acceptance of automotive AI technologies. Utilizing a one-way between-subjects design, the research presented online participants (N=478) with a text presenting guidelines for either trustworthy or reliable AI, before asking them to evaluate 3 vignette scenarios and fill in a modified version of the Technology Acceptance Model which covers different variables, such as perceived ease of use, human-like trust, and overall attitude.

arxiv-2503-04832.title: Lightweight FPGA Deployment of Learned Image Compression with Knowledge Distillation and Hybrid Quantization
arxiv-2503-04832.creator: Mazouz Alaa Eddine ID, Sumanta Chaudhuri ID, Attilio Fiandrotti ID, Marco Cagnazzo ID, Mihai Mitrea ID, Enzo Tartaglione ID
arxiv-2503-04832.description: Abstract Learnable Image Compression (LIC) has shown the potential to outperform standardized video codecs in RD efficiency, prompting the research for hardware-friendly implementations. Most existing LIC hardware implementations prioritize latency to RD-efficiency and through an extensive exploration of the hardware design space.

pmc-10542017.title: Brain development mediates the relationship between self-reported poor parental monitoring and adolescent anxiety
pmc-10542017.creator: Yiman Li, Zheyi Zhou, Yuqi Zhang, Hui Ai, Mingfang Liu, Jing Liu, Li Wang, Jiang Qiu, Zhuo Rachel Han, Zhanjun Zhang, Yue-Jia Luo, Pengfei Xu
pmc-10542017.description: Highlights•The default mode network plays a key role in predicting adolescent brain age.•The development speed of adolescent brain networks is closely linked to parenting.•Inadequate parental monitoring plays a crucial role in the development of specific brain networks associated with GAD in adolescents.

pmc-10599004.title: Wedge resection combined with 3D-printed polycaprolactone mesh for caudal septal deviation
pmc-10599004.creator: Jee Won Moon, Seok-Youl Choi, Su-Jong Kim, Jae-Min Shin, Il-Ho Park
pmc-10599004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundBiocompatibility and stability of three-dimensional printed polycaprolactone mesh grafts for nasal surgery are proven in both animal and human models. However, their safety and durability as batten grafts for caudal septal deviation has not been documented.

pmc-10675223.title: Development of Novel Monoclonal Antibodies to Wheat Alpha-Amylases Associated with Grain Quality Problems That Are Increasing with Climate Change
pmc-10675223.creator: Amber L. Hauvermale, Courtney Matzke, Gamila Bohaliga, Mike O. Pumphrey, Camille M. Steber, Andrew G. McCubbin
pmc-10675223.description: Accurate, rapid testing platforms are essential for early detection and mitigation of late maturity α-amylase (LMA) and preharvest sprouting (PHS) in wheat. These conditions are characterized by elevated α-amylase levels and negatively impact flour quality, resulting in substantial economic losses. The Hagberg–Perten Falling Number (FN) method is the industry standard for measuring α-amylase activity in wheatmeal.

pmc-11597634.title: Emergence of Carbapenem-Resistant Uropathogenic Escherichia coli (ST405 and ST167) Strains Carrying blaCTX-M-15, blaNDM-5 and Diverse Virulence Factors in Hospitalized Patients
pmc-11597634.creator: Fatima Mujahid, Muhammad Hidayat Rasool, Muhammad Shafiq, Bilal Aslam, Mohsin Khurshid, Karolina Akinosoglou
pmc-11597634.description: Background: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are common infectious diseases in hospital settings, and they are frequently caused by uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC). The emergence of carbapenem-resistant (Carb-R) E. coli strains poses a significant threat due to their multidrug resistance and virulence. This study aims to characterize the antimicrobial resistance and virulence profiles of Carb-R UPEC strains isolated from hospitalized patients.

pmc-11643739.title: Flavonoids and Other Polyphenols: Bioactive Molecules from Traditional Medicine Recipes/Medicinal Plants and Their Potential for Phytopharmaceutical and Medical Application
pmc-11643739.creator: Aekkhaluck Intharuksa, Sompop Kuljarusnont, Yohei Sasaki, Duangjai Tungmunnithum
pmc-11643739.description: Currently, natural bioactive ingredients and/or raw materials are of significant interest to scientists around the world. Flavonoids and other polyphenols are a major group of phytochemicals that have been researched and noted as bioactive molecules. They offer several pharmacological and medical benefits.

pmc-12568161.title: Pulmonary Embolism in Hospitalized COVID-19 Patients in Romania: Prevalence, Risk Factors, Outcomes
pmc-12568161.creator: Diana-Maria Mateescu, Adrian-Cosmin Ilie, Ioana Cotet, Cristina Guse, Camelia-Oana Muresan, Ana-Maria Pah, Marius Badalica-Petrescu, Stela Iurciuc, Maria-Laura Craciun, Adina Avram, Alexandra Enache, Eric Yager
pmc-12568161.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). (1) Background: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a severe complication of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), particularly in hospitalized patients. Data from Eastern Europe, including Romania, are limited, despite potential regional differences in demographics, comorbidities, and thromboprophylaxis practices. (2) Methods: This retrospective cohort study included 395 adults hospitalized with RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 at the “Victor Babeș” Clinical Hospital of Infectious Diseases and Pneumophthisiology, Timișoara, Romania, from September 2022 to December 2024. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, and imaging data were extracted from medical records.

pmc-12652275.title: Calcined Xerogels of C/TiO2 Nanostructures for Solar-Driven Photocatalytic Hydrogen Production
pmc-12652275.creator: Yong Li, Hongpeng Zhang, Canni Zhuo, Xixi Sun, Jiaqi Gao, Yali Zhao, Michael Arkas
pmc-12652275.description: The solar-driven water splitting for the production of renewable green hydrogen fundamentally relies on the exploration of efficient photocatalysts. Nanostructured TiO2 is widely recognized as a promising material for photocatalysis, yet it remains hindered by inadequate light harvesting and fast photogenerated carrier recombination.

pmc-12659609.title: Characterization of the Cellular Immune Response to Group B Streptococcal Vaginal Colonization
pmc-12659609.creator: Brady L. Spencer, Dustin T. Nguyen, Stephanie M. Marroquin, Laurent Gapin, Rebecca L. O’Brien, Kelly S. Doran
pmc-12659609.description: IntroductionGroup B Streptococcus (GBS) asymptomatic colonizes the female genital tract (FGT) but can contribute to adverse pregnancy outcomes including preterm birth, chorioamnionitis, and neonatal infection. We previously observed that GBS elicits FGT cytokine responses, including IL-17, during murine vaginal colonization; yet the anti-GBS cellular immune response during colonization remained unknown.

pmc-13007353.title: Effects of digital communication tools on patients, family members and health care professionals in adult ICUs: a mixed-methods systematic review
pmc-13007353.creator: Eunkyeong Oh, Anett Mueller-Alcazar, Sven Kottysch, Nikolas Groth, Candelaria Irene Mahlke
pmc-13007353.description: ObjectiveThe COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the rapid adoption of digital communication tools in clinical settings. This review aims to identify, synthesize, and critically appraise evidence on digital communication methods or interventions in adult intensive care units (ICUs) intended to promote the psychological and physical well-being of patients and their families, and to explore the associated impacts on healthcare professionals.

pmc-13078045.title: Clinical efficacy of Lactobacillus plantarum and Lactobacillus brevis as adjuncts to professional mechanical plaque removal in periodontitis: a systematic review
pmc-13078045.creator: RR Gheta Anggun Putri, Benso Sulijaya, Yuniarti Soeroso, Chia Wei Cheah, Dimas Ilham Hutomo
pmc-13078045.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis is a prevalent chronic inflammatory disease marked by progressive periodontal tissue destruction. It is classified according to the 2017 AAP/EFP staging and grading framework and managed in accordance with the EFP S3-level guideline. Professional mechanical plaque removal (PMPR) remains the cornerstone of non-surgical therapy. However, its limited effectiveness in deep periodontal pockets has prompted interest in adjunctive probiotic approaches.

pmc-13123877.title: Results From the Practice Accreditation Resident Reviewer Program (PARRP) Pilot: Educating Radiation Oncology Residents About Practice Accreditation
pmc-13123877.creator: Niema B Razavian, Alexis N Schutz, Leslie Chang, Valerie Guth, Srinath Sundararaman, Rojymon Jacob, Kathryn Huber, Steven J Feigenberg, Jaroslaw T Hepel
pmc-13123877.description: Introduction: While instruction in patient safety and quality improvement is a core requirement for radiation oncology graduate medical education, many residents feel their training in this domain is inadequate. To address this discrepancy, we developed a mentorship program that allows residents to serve as junior reviewers within the American College of Radiation Oncology (ACRO) Practice Accreditation Program.
